title: Agents
subtitle: A token lets an agent start and use its own browser sessions.
mcp.before: Agents connect through the agent API or MCP at
empty.watch: You watch, take over and stop its sessions in Sessions.
empty.revoke: Revoking its token stops that agent and its sessions at once.
revoke.confirm: Revoke “{name}”? Every session it started stops now.
create.title: New agent token
create.subtitle: Lets one agent start and use its own sessions.
create.name: Name
created.title: Token created
created.subtitle: Give it to your agent. It is shown only this once.
created.copyNow: “{name}” — copy it now: it is not shown again.
created.refused: Copying was refused; select the token and copy it yourself.
command.refused: Copying was refused; the command is selected, copy it yourself.
create.name.help: Something you’ll recognize, like “Claude on my laptop”.
files.title: Files
files.subtitle: What every agent may do with files while it holds a session's control. A change applies at once, to running sessions too.
files.loading: Loading what agents may do with files
files.downloads.help: Asking shows the request on the session's page; the agent waits up to 2 minutes for your answer.
files.transfers: Send its own files into the browser
files.transfers.help: A file it made or has, like an image, ready for the page.
notify.title: Notifications
notify.subtitle: When an agent needs you (a login, an approval, locked saved sessions), easi.run posts to your webhook. Slack and Discord incoming webhooks show it as it comes.
notify.url.help: An https:// address. Each post is signed with a secret you get once.
notify.remove.confirm: Remove the webhook? Nothing is posted until you set one again.
notify.secret.help: Copy it now: it is not shown again. Each post carries easi-run-signature: t=<time>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256 of "<time>.<body>">.
